LightningComponentBundle.description: Rebuild viewer (P0): renders a published Spec_JSON__c through the final* pipeline — engine tokens, layout registry, pageFrame chrome.

property.name: formId
property.label: Form Id
property.description: Form to render (active published version). A ?c__formId= URL parameter overrides this.

property.name: versionId
property.label: Version Id (optional)
property.description: Render a specific version instead. A ?c__versionId= URL parameter overrides this.

property.name: existingRecordId
property.label: Existing Record Id (optional)
property.description: Forms: leave blank to create. Enter a record ID, recordId, or {!recordId} to edit. Current-record expressions require a record page. URL fallback: c__existingRecordId.

property.name: surveyContextRecordId
property.label: Survey Context Record Id (optional)
property.description: Surveys: optional record for prefill, visibility rules and mapped writeback. Enter a record ID, recordId, or {!recordId}. URL fallback: c__surveyContextRecordId.
